commands:
set -eu
aws s3 cp s3://fyp-p82-20261005-018da1d6-803656589923/source/integrity-v3.1.zip /tmp/integrity-v3.1.zip --region ap-southeast-2
echo '3da855b2966b6668979bde7fbcef6e5c7a91106af60181235db16a8a5b63e331  /tmp/integrity-v3.1.zip' | sha256sum -c -
mkdir /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v3.1 /srv/fyp-p82-v3.1-integrity /srv/fyp-p82-backup-v3.1-integrity
unzip -q /tmp/integrity-v3.1.zip -d /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v3.1
chown -R fyp:fyp /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v3.1 /srv/fyp-p82-v3.1-integrity /srv/fyp-p82-backup-v3.1-integrity
cd /opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1
runuser -u fyp -- env P8_DOCKER_DATA_PATH=/srv/fyp-p82-v3.1-integrity .venv/bin/python /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v3.1/runner_v3.py init --root /srv/fyp-p82-v3.1-integrity/zero-admission --backup /srv/fyp-p82-backup-v3.1-integrity/zero-admission >/srv/fyp-p82-v3.1-integrity/init.txt 2>&1
runuser -u fyp -- .venv/bin/python /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v3.1/runner_v3.py verify --root /srv/fyp-p82-v3.1-integrity/zero-admission >/srv/fyp-p82-v3.1-integrity/verify.txt 2>&1
python3.12 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,sqlite3,json
root=pathlib.Path('/srv/fyp-p82-v3.1-integrity')
with sqlite3.connect(root/'zero-admission/ledger.sqlite3') as db:
    rows=db.execute('SELECT label,attempt,execution_id FROM slots ORDER BY sequence').fetchall()
assert rows[0]==('DIAGNOSTIC_RERUN',2,None) and all(x[2] is None for x in rows)
(root/'success.json').write_text(json.dumps({'init_verify':'PASS','rows':rows,'admitted_business_slots':0,'main_started':False}))
print((root/'success.json').read_text())
PY
archive=/srv/fyp-p82-v3.1-integrity-evidence.tar.gz
tar -czf "$archive" -C /srv fyp-p82-v3.1-integrity fyp-p82-backup-v3.1-integrity
sha=$(sha256sum "$archive" | cut -d' ' -f1)
aws s3api put-object --bucket fyp-p82-20261005-018da1d6-803656589923 --key "exports/phase82-v3.1-integrity-$sha.tar.gz" --body "$archive" --checksum-algorithm SHA256 --metadata "sha256=$sha" --region ap-southeast-2
